name: tower
description: One place to see what a Claude session is costing, what its agents are doing, how far the build is, and whether Tank is healthy.

usageBand.title: Usage band
usageBand.description: Show usage windows, prompt-cache state and session cost above the prompt.

bandLayout.title: Band layout
bandLayout.description: rows is one dense line per figure. dials draws each window as a gauge. hero gives the window that will stop you first the space and shrinks the rest. cards puts each figure on its own tile. The terminal always draws rows, having no way to draw the others.

agentsPanel.title: Agents panel
agentsPanel.description: Track subagents: what they are doing, what they cost and how far along they are.

buildBar.title: Build status bar
buildBar.description: Show build progress with an estimated finish for local, CI and Tank builds.
